Definition: to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pour, run, flow, pour down; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be poured, be spilt; 1a2) to pour oneself, flow, trickle; 1a3) to vanish (fig.); 1a4) to be stretched out; 1b) (Hiphil) to pour down; 1c) (Hophal) to melt
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
